Comments on tasks and quests: add, list, show, link

Durable, git-tracked comments for inter-agent and human communication. One file per comment under .wombo-combo/comments/&lt;task\|quest&gt;/&lt;ref-id&gt;/. A ref is a task ID or quest:&lt;quest-id&gt;. The author defaults to WOMBO_AUTHOR, then git user.email, then the OS user.

```sh
woco comment <subcommand> [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |

## comment add

Add a comment to a task or quest

```sh
woco comment add <ref> [text] [flags]
```

Modifies project state.

### Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | yes | Task ID or quest:&lt;quest-id&gt; |
| `text` | no | Comment text (remaining words are joined) |

### Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--role` |  | string |  | Author role: agent (default), human, or system |
| `--author` |  | string |  | Author (default: WOMBO_AUTHOR, git user.email, OS user) |
| `--reply-to` |  | string |  | Comment ID this comment replies to |
| `--github-url` |  | string |  | URL of the mirrored GitHub issue comment |
| `--stdin` |  | boolean | `false` | Read the comment text from stdin |

### Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |

## comment list

```sh

```

Read-only.

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ref` | yes | Task ID or quest:&lt;quest-id&gt; |
